teaser.en: A single breadfruit, roasted or simmered in coconut milk, can feed a family, and it grows on a tree.
teaser.sw: Shelisheli moja, likichomwa au kupikwa kwa tui la nazi, linaweza kulisha familia nzima, na linaota juu ya mti.

summary.en: Breadfruit is a handsome tree with huge lobed leaves and round, starchy fruits, planted at the coast. The fruit is baked or boiled, often in coconut milk, and eaten like a vegetable.
summary.sw: Mshelisheli ni mti mzuri wenye majani makubwa yaliyokatika na matunda ya mviringo yenye wanga, unaopandwa pwani. Tunda huokwa au huchemshwa, mara nyingi kwa tui la nazi, na huliwa kama mboga.

about.en:
Breadfruit is a tall, spreading evergreen tree with very large, glossy leaves deeply cut into lobes, which make it easy to recognise even from a distance. Cut any part of it and a sticky white latex flows.

The fruits are round to oval, about the size of a large grapefruit, with a green skin patterned in small bumps or plates. Inside is pale, starchy flesh that becomes soft and bread-like when cooked.
about.sw:
Mshelisheli ni mti mrefu wa kijani kibichi daima unaotanda, wenye majani makubwa sana yanayong'aa yaliyokatika kwa kina, ambayo huufanya kuwa rahisi kuutambua hata ukiwa mbali. Ukikata sehemu yoyote yake, utomvu mweupe unaonata hutiririka.

Matunda ni ya mviringo hadi umbo la yai, kwa ukubwa wa balungi kubwa, yenye ganda la kijani lenye vivimbe vidogo au vibapa. Ndani kuna nyama hafifu yenye wanga inayokuwa laini kama mkate ikipikwa.

where.en: Breadfruit is planted at the coast, usually near homes and in old town gardens, where a single tree can shade a whole yard.
where.sw: Mshelisheli hupandwa pwani, kwa kawaida karibu na nyumba na katika bustani za miji ya zamani, ambako mti mmoja unaweza kutia kivuli uwanja mzima.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten while still firm and starchy, before it turns sweet. It is baked or boiled, and often cooked in coconut milk, much like cassava or green bananas.
uses.sw: Tunda huliwa likiwa bado gumu na lenye wanga, kabla halijawa tamu. Huokwa au huchemshwa, na mara nyingi hupikwa kwa tui la nazi, kama vile mhogo au ndizi mbichi.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili: *mshelisheli*, with the fruit called *shelisheli*. English: breadfruit. Scientists call it *Artocarpus altilis*. It is a close relative of the jackfruit.
names.sw: Bado hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa. Kiswahili: *mshelisheli*, na tunda huitwa *shelisheli*. Kwa Kiingereza: *breadfruit*. Wanasayansi huuita *Artocarpus altilis*. Ni ndugu wa karibu wa mfenesi.

reason.en: Cassava, another starch cooked in coconut milk
reason.sw: Mhogo, chakula kingine cha wanga kinachopikwa kwa tui la nazi

reason.en: Plantain, also cooked as a starchy vegetable
reason.sw: Ndizi za kupika, pia hupikwa kama mboga ya wanga

reason.en: Coconut, whose milk cooks the fruit
reason.sw: Mnazi, ambao tui lake hupikia tunda hili

sources: Maundu & Tengnäs (eds.) (2005) Useful Trees and Shrubs for Kenya, ICRAF/World Agroforestry species sheet https://apps.worldagroforestry.org/usefultrees/pdflib/Artocarpus_heterophyllus_KEN.pdf (remarks on A. altilis)
